verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's developer docs describe V3 webhooks as a first-class subscription mechanism for incident/priority/responder change events, and the Events API v2 (confirmed live via runtime probe) provides the complementary ingestion side, giving AI-native integrators a documented way to subscribe to and consume PagerDuty events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook subscription setup and payload handling, and no direct linkage of webhooks specifically to AI-agent workflows.
